behavior: make provision NODE=ace2 ENV=staging converges at the role level (second run reports 0 changed) and coexists with the running Ollama service. Scoped deliberately to role-level convergence: the dotfiles bootstrap task derives changed_when from the clone state, so setup-linux.sh's own internal idempotence is NOT measured by this criterion (ANSIBLE-031 / #863)
verification: make provision NODE=ace2 ENV=staging TAGS=dev_node | tee /tmp/p1 && make provision NODE=ace2 ENV=staging TAGS=dev_node | tee /tmp/p2 && grep -qE 'changed=0 .*failed=0' /tmp/p2
evidence: 2026-08-07: re-verified with the CORRECTED command after the criterion text was found unrunnable — it said `make provision ... --tags dev_node`, and make rejects that (`make: unrecognized option '--tags'`); the Makefile takes `TAGS=`. Two consecutive runs of the corrected form against a live ace2: pass 1 ok=29 changed=2 failed=0 (dotfiles clone pulled mlorentedev/dotfiles#788 + bootstrap re-ran), pass 2 ok=29 changed=0 failed=0. Convergence holds across a dotfiles update, which is the stronger test — the single-owner split means an upstream dotfiles change costs exactly one changed pass, not a permanent delta. 2026-08-06: PASS after the ownership refactor. Two consecutive full runs (TAGS=dev_node): pass 1 ok=29 changed=4 failed=0, pass 2 ok=29 changed=0 failed=0, exit 0 both. No task reports changed on the second pass. The earlier failure (changed=2 forever) was dual ownership: the role injected into ~/.bashrc, ~/.zshrc and ~/.tmux.conf, which setup-linux.sh redeploys wholesale every run. Fixed by writing only to files dotfiles never touches — ~/.bashrc.local + ~/.zshrc.local (the IDEAS-001 seam, sourced last by the tracked rc files) and ~/.tmux.conf.local (new seam, mlorentedev/dotfiles#788) — plus /etc/profile.d/mise.sh. Ownership proof: after pass 2, ~/.bashrc mtime 04:38:21 (rewritten by the bootstrap) vs ~/.bashrc.local mtime 04:37:55 (written in pass 1, untouched). CAVEAT (#863): this proves the ROLE converges. It does not measure setup-linux.sh's own idempotency — that task always runs and its changed_when is bound to the git clone, so its changed=0 is structural, not evidence. Unchanged by this work; still tracked in ANSIBLE-031.

evidence: 2026-08-06: exact criterion command PASS on ace2 — nvim (/usr/bin/nvim), gh (/usr/bin/gh), ~/.tmux/plugins/tmux-resurrect and ~/Projects/Workspace/dotfiles all present. 2026-08-07: 'present' upgraded to 'actually loads' after mlorentedev/dotfiles#788 merged and a re-provision pulled it — ~/.tmux.conf:56 now carries `if-shell "test -f ~/.tmux.conf.local" "source-file ~/.tmux.conf.local"`, and on an isolated socket (`tmux -L resurrectcheck -f ~/.tmux.conf`) the plugin registers its bindings: prefix C-s -> scripts/save.sh, prefix C-r -> scripts/restore.sh, plus 4 @resurrect-* options. behavior: mise is installed; the global config pins node/go/python; they resolve in login and interactive shells (shims via /etc/profile.d/mise.sh and the .bashrc.local/.zshrc.local seam)
verification: ssh ace2 'bash -lc "mise list && node --version && go version && python --version"' && ssh ace2 'bash -ic "node --version && go version && python --version"'
evidence: 2026-08-07: criterion command re-run AS REWRITTEN against a live ace2 — both halves rc=0. Login (`bash -lc`, via /etc/profile.d/mise.sh): `mise list` shows go 1.26.5 / node 24.19.0 / python 3.12.13 all sourced from ~/.config/mise/config.toml, and node/go/python report v24.19.0, go1.26.5, Python 3.12.13. Interactive (`bash -ic`, via the .bashrc.local seam): same three versions. (`bash -ic` over ssh emits 'cannot set terminal process group' / 'no job control' on stderr — cosmetic, there is no TTY; exit status is 0.) Two defects were fixed to get here: (a) the activation block ran before the dotfiles bootstrap, which deploys its own .bashrc/.zshrc and clobbered it — reordered, then moved to the .local seam so ownership is single; (b) `mise activate` is an interactive-only eval — replaced with shims on PATH. 2026-08-07: criterion NARROWED to login+interactive by human decision. Non-interactive `ssh host 'cmd'` remains out of scope and is not a defect of this role: that shell class reads neither /etc/profile.d nor ~/.bashrc (Ubuntu's stock copy returns at `[[ $- != *i* ]]`), so no role-level change reaches it. Accepted because every consumer in ADR-058 D1 is interactive or path-explicit — agents run inside tmux sessions (interactive), and the role's own toolchain task invokes mise by absolute path, never a bare `node|go|python`. Rejected alternatives: /etc/environment (static system-wide PATH, loses the per-user `id -un` guard so root would inherit another user's toolchain) and an explicit shims var in every task (permanent discipline cost). See verification.md 'Scope of f4'.
